metadata.title: PaperNote - Scientific Article Analysis
metadata.description: Analyze your scientific articles with artificial intelligence. Get a detailed score and comprehensive report.

home.heroDescription: Submit your scientific article and get a detailed analysis with a score, comprehensive report, and actionable recommendations.

features.title: Advanced AI Analysis
features.description: Our AI evaluates your article based on 8 scientific criteria and provides a score out of 100.

features.title: Detailed Score
features.description: Get a numeric evaluation per criterion with a complete strengths/weaknesses report.

features.title: Multiple Formats
features.description: Import your articles in PDF, DOCX, TEX, TXT or MD. Drag and drop or paste the text.

features.title: Recommendations
features.description: A clear verdict: Accepted, Minor Revisions, Major Revisions, or Rejected.

steps.title: Submit Your Article
steps.description: Paste the content or import a file. Add title, author(s) and target journal.

steps.title: In-Depth AI Analysis
steps.description: Gemini AI evaluates your article based on 8 rigorous scientific criteria.

steps.title: Receive Your Report
steps.description: Overall score, per-criterion details, strengths, weaknesses, and concrete recommendations.

home.criteriaDescription: Each article is analyzed based on these scientific criteria.
home.ctaDescription: Create your free account and get a detailed analysis of your scientific article.
home.footerDisclaimer1: PaperNote uses AI to provide indicative analyses.
home.footerDisclaimer2: Results do not replace peer review by an expert.
